references.context: Raise the spinner value with the six METEOR drop targets.
references.label: METEOR drop targets
references.description: Leave one small letter standing to preserve the 2,000 spinner.

references.context: Repeat the spinner from the left flipper.
references.label: Spinner
references.description: Its value rises with each down METEOR letter.

references.context: Use the upper-left number 2 bank as the recovery route.
references.label: Number 2 bank
references.description: Build the stored number 2 Bonus value here.

references.context: The three numbered banks build separate Bonus values.
references.label: Numbered drop-target banks
references.description: Build the three stored Bonus values toward 21,000 total.

references.context: Lit inlanes and top rollovers can spot the final METEOR letter.
references.label: Lit inlanes and top rollovers
references.description: A lit lane can complete the remaining letter and reset the bank.

references.context: Test the center-post response before transferring the ball.
references.label: Center post
references.description: Its rebound determines whether a post pass is controlled.
